tei:div.tei:p: 'dir ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ston pa'i dbang du mdzad nas rtsa ba'i lung so thar mdo dang*/ bshad lung sde bzhi ste/ 'dul ba gzhi dang*/ rnam 'byed dang*/ gzhung dam pa dang*/ 'dul ba phran tshegs gsungs pa rnams kyi tshig don gtso bo rnams 'du zhing*/ don bde blag tu rtogs par mdzad pa'i bstan bcos me tog phreng rgyud ces bya ba 'di ni/ 'dul 'dzin chen po 'phags pa dge 'dun 'bangs kyi slob ma/ 'phags pa sa ga'i lhas mdzad pa yin zhing*/ slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis mdzad pa'i 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba las/ khyad chos lngas khyad par du 'phags te/ rtsom pa po dgra bcom pa yin zhing*/ gleng gzhi rtsa bas zin pa/ tshig nyung zhing don rgya che ba/ tshig gi sdeb sbyor legs shing*/ don go sla ba'o/ /gzhung tshad ni/ bam po drug yod pa las/ bam po dang po la sh+lau ka 295 bam po gnyis pa la sh+lau ka 303 bam po gsum pa la sh+lau ka 312 bam po bzhi pa la sh+lau ka 348 bam po lnga pa la sh+lau ka 265 bam po drug pa la sh+lau ka 175 bcas so// gzhung 'di ni gdul bya le lo can dang*/ shes rab dman pa dag 'dul ba'i bka' bstan bcos rgya chen po rnams la thos bsam byed mi nus pas/ de dag 'dul ba'i gzhung la 'jug pa'i them skas lta bu yin te/ dgra bcom pa sa ga'i lhas/ le lo can dang blo dman dag/gzhung mangs rnams kyis 'jigs pa ni/ /legs gsungs 'dul ba'i rgya mtsho la/ /yon tan ldan yang 'dod mi byed/ /de phyir de dag gzhug don du/ /skyo med 'gro ba'i che ba yi/ /tshig ler byas pa'i them skas kyis/ /rtag tu mu stegs ston byed bzhin/ /zhes gsungs so// dge tshul kā ri kā lnga bcu pa/ kha che slob dpon dge 'dun bzang pos mdzad pa'i dge tshul kā ri kā lnga bcu pa 'dis/ dge tshul gyi bslab gzhi mtha' dag don brgyad du bsdus nas bstan te/ 1 bstod cing phyag 'tshal ba dang*/

2 bslab pa nyams su blangs ba dang*/ 3 snga dro'i dus na las gang bya ba dang*/ 4 zas kyi bya ba byas pa'i 'og tu las gang bya ba dang*/ 5 phas pham pa'i gnas dang*/ 6 bslab pa phra mo'i gnas dang*/ 7 phyi dro phan chad ji ltar bya ba dang*/ 8 'bras bu ji ltar bya ba bzhin du bstan pa'o// dge tshul kā ri kā sum brgya pa/ slob dpon shākya 'od kyis mdzad pa'i dge tshul kā ri kā sum brgya pa 'dis mgo mjug tu bsdu na dge tshul gyi bslab gzhi bcu dang*/ phyogs mthun nyams pa rnam bzhi spong ba dang*/ 'dul ba mdor bsdus bcas don rnam pa bco lngar bsdus te rgyas par bstan to/ /de la bslab gzhi bcu ni/ sum brgya pa las/ gang zhig srog gcod gzhan gyi nor 'phrog dang*/ /mi tshangs spyod brdzun bcos pa'i chang la sogs/ /gar sogs phreng sogs mal che mtho ba dang*// phyi dro'i kha zas dngul nyid spong ba ste/ /zhes gsungs so// bslab gzhi bcu po 'di dag ni dge tshul pha ma gnyis kas bslab par bya ba yin te/ 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud las/ bcu yi gnas la dge tshul nyid/ /dge tshul ma yang de bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so// phyogs mthun nyams pa rnam bzhi ni/ khyim pa'i rtags spong ba'i phyogs mthun dang*/ rab tu byung ba nyams pa'i phyogs mthun dang*/ bla mar gsol ba btab pa las nyams pa'i phyogs mthun dang*/ sdom pa mtha' dag nyams pa'i phyogs dang mthun pa rnams so/ /gzhung 'dir dge tshul gyi bslab bya phyogs mthun dang bcas pa zhib phra gsal zhing*/ khyad par 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i khungs gsal bar drangs te ston pa'o// des na 'dul ba'i gzhung gsum po 'di nyid 'di ga wā ṇa badz+ra bid+yā gtsug lag slob gnyer khang gi 'dul ba'i zur blta'i slob tshan du bzhag ste/ 'chad nyan gnang bzhin yin pas/ da cha slob gnyer ba rnams la thugs mkho yod par brten/ rang dgon gyi bla ma karma dbang rgyal mchog nas par skrun gyi sbyin bdag gnang ba la thugs rje che zhu rgyu lags/

de bzhin ma phyi gsal po ma thob pa dang*/ zhu dag gnad smin ma song ba sogs kyis lhag chad dang*/ nor 'khrul byung ba thams cad mkhas dbang rnams kyi drung du bshags shing*/ nor bcos bka' bslab kyang lhug stsol gnang ba'i bka' drin zhu/ wā ṇa badz+ra bid+yā dpe mdzod khang nas/ phyi lo 2005 zla ba 11 tshes 15 nyin dge slong tshe ring pas/
